plain_statement.zh: 从有限个高峰层推出深次弧预算
plain_statement.en: Deduce the deep-minor spike budget from the surviving height bins

brief.zh: 每层上端纳入本层，下端归入前层。有限望远镜求和后给高层与低层各留 n/4608。高层总数最多 ⌊log₂ n⌋+3，系数 100000 足以守住预算。
brief.en: Use open lower and closed upper bin boundaries. Telescope the finite sum and allocate n/4608 to each of the low and high ranges. There are at most floor(log₂ n)+3 bins, within the numerical allowance.
